pain: PROBLEM 01 — learners memorize new words and forget them within days

slides.headline: You'll forget *3 out of 4* new words by next week.
slides.speech: You'll forget three out of four new words by next week.

slides.headline: The forgetting curve
slides.source: Ebbinghaus (1885) — share forgotten after one study session
slides.speech: This is the forgetting curve. One hour later, more than half is gone. Six days later, three quarters.

slides.headline: It's not your memory.
slides.sub: You learned the word *naked* — alone, with no sentence to hold it.
slides.speech: It's not your memory. You learned the word naked. Alone. With no sentence to hold it.

slides.headline: The fix: *one sentence* + review on day *1 · 3 · 7*
slides.speech: The fix: learn it inside one sentence, then review it on day one, three and seven. Every review flattens the curve.

slides.example: She stayed resilient after losing her job.
slides.speech: Like this. Resilient. She stayed resilient after losing her job.

slides.headline: Every word on *anotherwordfor.net* comes with a sentence.
slides.sub: Save this · Ep 2: the day 1-3-7 routine
